description: North Central Provincial Council - Notify the Pawnbrokers Statute N0. 03 of 2017 of the Provincial Council of North Central Province
categorisation: The gazette content pertains to the enactment of the "North Central Province Pawnbrokers Statute No. 03 of 2017," which is a new provincial law establishing a regulatory framework for pawnbrokers. This involves creating new legal requirements, registration and licensing procedures, and compliance rules, making it a clear example of a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5). It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, or elections.
